images.caption: Church of the Straits in Mackinaw City, Michigan. Since 1962, this church has been federated and as of 2024 is dually affiliated with ECO: A Covenant Order of Evangelical Presbyterians and the Global

place.source_title: Church of the Straits, Mackinaw City

brief: A 1970s church: a steep A-frame-like brown shingled roof sweeping almost to the ground, a tall slender steel cross-spire on the ridge, brick end walls with a glazed gable, a car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Church of the Straits (Mackinaw City MI, c.1975): a red-brick church under a huge folded standing-seam roof that peaks into a diamond gable over the entry, a steel-frame open spire with a cross; a lower wing; a big asphalt parking lot in front, old bells on display, a wooden nativity shed

why.note: postwar suburban churches: the steep folded roof as the steeple, the parking lot as the churchyard
